subject: Quick question about the shipment
outgoing: Hey, just wanted to check: did the last batch of samples arrive okay? Let me know if you need anything else from our end.
reply: Yes, got them yesterday! Everything looks good. Thanks for checking in.

subject: Updated pricing sheet
outgoing: Hi there, I just sent over the updated Q2 pricing. Take a look when you get a chance and let me know your thoughts.
reply: Thanks for sending this over. I'll review it this week and get back to you.

subject: Meeting follow-up
outgoing: Great talking with you earlier. I'll put together the wholesale catalog you asked about and send it over by Friday.
reply: Sounds great, looking forward to it! Talk soon.

subject: Trade show next month
outgoing: Are you planning to attend the expo next month? We'll have a booth there and it would be great to connect in person.
reply: I'll be there! Let's definitely meet up. What day works best?

subject: Invoice question
outgoing: Just wanted to confirm: did you receive the invoice I sent last week? I want to make sure our records are aligned.
reply: Yes, got it. Payment will go out this Friday as usual.

subject: Shipping update
outgoing: Quick heads up: your order shipped this morning. Tracking number is in the system. Should arrive by Thursday.
reply: Awesome, thanks for the heads up! Really appreciate the fast turnaround.

subject: Quarterly review
outgoing: Time for our quarterly review! I put together some numbers on our volume over the past 3 months. Let me know when you're free to discuss.
reply: How about next Tuesday at 2pm? I'll have my team join as well.

subject: Order confirmation
outgoing: Confirming your order for 50 units. We'll have it ready for pickup by next Monday.
reply: Confirmed, thanks! We'll arrange pickup on Monday morning.

subject: Packaging options
outgoing: We're considering some new packaging options for our wholesale line. Would you prefer bulk bags or individually sealed units?
reply: Individually sealed would be ideal for our retail partners. Good call on updating the packaging.

subject: Document request
outgoing: Could you send me the updated import paperwork when you have a chance? I want to make sure we have everything filed before the next shipment.
reply: Sure thing, I'll have it over to you by end of day tomorrow.
